easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters.
description:
Deal damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters.
Sun-Crowned Hunters and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Sun-Crowned Hunters trigger, dealing damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters.
Repeat from step 2.
